verdict.rationale: The evidence covers real-time conversational agents: a visual workflow builder for multi-step conversation flows, and tools and webhooks that fire during a conversation. Nothing documents automations that run on their own in the background, such as scheduled or recurring runs or event-triggered jobs that need no live conversation. The workflow builder and in-conversation actions are adjacent features, not the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
